mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 1 month does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns with a Rank IC above 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strong consumer-driven economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of RSAFS and UNRATE does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25pp in 1 month does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in a low-interest-rate environment.
regime_hint: robust economic growth with low interest rates
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases over 2 consecutive quarters do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances, especially when FEDFUNDS is low.
